Description of the incident *

     On that day, September 8, 1952, shifts of 3x6 hours were being worked, when during the shift from 9 pm to 12 am, the incident occurred.

     At precisely 11:45 pm, according to witnesses, what they call a huge flash of light illuminated a large area, visible from post 13, located to the southwest of the prison, as far as approximately 1 km into the woods.
